title: VEF value dimensions v1alpha1
description: Product-agnostic value dimensions for the full business impact claim chain.

value_usd.description: Calculated USD value for this dimension. Present in evaluated output; optional in input (calculated by the framework).

inputs.description: Dimension-specific inputs. Schema varies by dimension type.

source.description: Where the inputs came from (e.g. pilot_work_log, customer_input, industry_benchmark).

inference_cost_avoided_inputs.description: Model inference calls that did not happen.

infrastructure_cost_avoided_inputs.description: Hardware, power, or cloud API costs for inference not needed.

human_operational_cost_avoided_inputs.description: Engineer time not spent triaging and investigating signals.

human_touch_rate.description: Fraction of suppressed signals that would have actually reached a human without the product (default 0.30). Accounts for existing automation — PagerDuty grouping, silence rules, runbooks.

incident_response_value_inputs.description: Value of faster incident detection and response.

downstream_business_impact_inputs.description: SLA penalties avoided, user productivity preserved, support tickets prevented.

organizational_knowledge_value_inputs.description: OKV — value of institutional knowledge captured, retained, and made accessible across the organization. Three value paths: decision acceleration, onboarding acceleration, and knowledge retention.

decisions_informed_per_period.description: Number of decisions informed by recalled institutional knowledge in the claim period.

avg_decision_time_saved_minutes.description: Average time saved per informed decision vs re-investigating. Default 15 min.

loaded_hourly_rate_usd.description: Blended hourly rate across knowledge consumers. Default $85.

new_hires_per_year.description: Annual new hires in functions served by the knowledge system.

onboarding_weeks_baseline.description: Baseline weeks to full productivity for new hires. Default 12.

onboarding_weeks_reduction.description: Weeks saved by having institutional knowledge available. Default 25% of baseline.

new_hire_loaded_cost_per_week_usd.description: Weekly loaded cost of a new hire during ramp. Default $3,400.

knowledge_consumers.description: Number of people across all functions who benefit from the knowledge system.

knowledge_loss_per_departure_usd.description: Estimated institutional knowledge cost lost per departing employee. Default $50,000.

knowledge_retention_factor.description: Fraction of knowledge loss prevented by the system (0 = none, 1 = all). No default — must be estimated per deployment.

memories_formed.description: Portfolio indicator — total memories formed in the period. Not directly costed.

causal_links_discovered.description: Portfolio indicator — cross-domain causal links discovered. Not directly costed.

knowledge_domains.description: Which domains feed the knowledge system (e.g. kubernetes, aap, jira, confluence).

human_cost_of_ownership_inputs.description: HCO — the human price of automation. Reskilling, productivity loss during transition, and attrition risk when work is displaced. This is a cost dimension: it subtracts from gross value.

fte_displaced.description: Fractional FTE of work displaced by the automation (e.g. 0.1 = 10% of one role).

annual_loaded_cost_per_fte_usd.description: Fully loaded annual cost per affected FTE (salary + benefits + overhead).

current_headcount_in_function.description: Current headcount in the affected function. Used to calculate displacement ratio — how much of the team's work is being displaced.

reskilling_cost_per_fte_usd.description: Investment to retrain each displaced FTE. Default $24,800 (SHRM 2024).

transition_months.description: Duration of the role transition. Default 6 months.

productivity_loss_during_transition.description: Fraction of productivity lost during transition. Default 0.20.

attrition_risk.description: Probability the displaced person leaves during transition. Default 0.15.

replacement_cost_factor.description: Cost to replace as a multiple of annual salary. Default 0.50.

amortization_days.description: Days over which the transition cost is amortized. Default 365.

reskilling_pathway.description: Where displaced capacity goes. Each entry maps a current role to a target role with status tracking.

from.description: Current role or function being displaced.

to.description: Target role or function after reskilling.

fte.description: FTE capacity being redirected in this pathway.

status.description: Current state of this reskilling pathway.
